editorial.meta_description: The ITIL 4 Specialist: Sustainability in Digital and IT certification is officially scheduled for retirement by PeopleCert (AXELOS) on the date of 2027-12-31.
editorial.overview: The ITIL 4 Specialist: Sustainability in Digital and IT certification, managed by PeopleCert (AXELOS), covers the integration of sustainability into digital and IT services. It examines how organizations can align IT practices with environmental goals, focusing on carbon efficiency, energy management, and sustainability frameworks. This exam is scheduled for retirement on 2027-12-31, and no successor has been named by the certifying body. Candidates should prepare for an evaluation of how digital infrastructure impacts the environment and how to mitigate those effects through strategic management and technical improvements within the IT lifecycle.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is intended for IT professionals, service managers, and practitioners involved in building, deploying, or managing digital services. It is highly suitable for those aiming to apply sustainability principles to their existing IT practices and organizational processes to improve overall environmental performance.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official PeopleCert (AXELOS) study documentation to understand the core principles of sustainability in IT. Focus on the three domains: concepts, frameworks, and practical application. Since the exam is a 90-minute linear test with 40 questions, practice applying theory to real-world scenarios. Ensure you understand the definitions of carbon efficiency and energy efficiency as described in the provided source materials. Candidates must be prepared to answer 40 questions within the 90-minute limit, requiring a strong grasp of the material to achieve the 70 passing score.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the fundamental concepts of sustainability within the context of digital and IT environments, including the impact of greenhouse gases and global warming on the planet and modern business operations.

This domain focuses on the international standards and frameworks used to monitor and guide sustainability efforts in the IT sector, ensuring that organizations remain compliant with global environmental regulations and best practices.

This domain addresses the practical application of sustainability, including how to embed green practices into daily IT operations and software development to reduce the overall environmental footprint of digital service delivery.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam consists of 40 multiple-choice questions. You have 90 minutes to complete the test. A passing score of 70 is required. Manage your time effectively across all three domains to ensure you address every question before the timer expires.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam contains exactly 40 multiple-choice questions that cover the three domains of sustainability in digital and IT. Candidates must answer these questions within the allotted time to demonstrate their proficiency.
To pass the ITIL 4 Specialist: Sustainability in Digital and IT exam, you must achieve a minimum score of 70. This threshold ensures that candidates have mastered the core sustainability concepts.

The exam is a 90-minute linear assessment consisting of 40 multiple-choice questions. Candidates are encouraged to manage their time carefully throughout the duration of the test to ensure completion.

faq.question_title: What is the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam price is 430 USD. Please verify current pricing and any additional regional fees directly through the official PeopleCert (AXELOS) website before you register for your scheduled exam session.

methodology.summary: This page was built by synthesizing official PeopleCert (AXELOS) documentation and verified exam facts to provide a clear overview of the certification requirements and status for all users.
